name: AI Automator Extractor
description: For extracting data from text without AI.
project_description: AI Automator Extractor provides a set of AI Automators field-processor plugins that pull structured values out of a source field using plain PHP and regular expressions - no AI/LLM call is made. It is meant for the deterministic parts of an AI Automators workflow: extracting links, e-mails, image URLs or file URLs from unstructured text or scraped HTML, running an arbitrary regular expression to fill a text/string field, or counting regex matches into an integer field. The image and file extractors go a step further and download the matched URLs server-side, saving them as file/image entities on the target field. The module ships seven AiAutomatorType plugins (Link, Email, Image, File, RegEx Text, RegEx Text for string fields, RegEx Counter) and supersedes the older AI Interpolator Extractor on Drupal 10.3+. It has no routes, permissions, config or Drush of its own, and depends on the AI module's ai_automators sub-module (composer: drupal/ai). Supports Drupal 10.3 and 11.
